intro: The eleven-minute closer of Highway 61 Revisited, a long parade of characters from history and fiction. The only acoustic song on an electric album.

lives.title: Electric first
lives.note: Tried with a band first. The electric take came out on The Cutting Edge.

lives.title: Acoustic master
lives.note: Re-cut acoustic with Charlie McCoy's Spanish-flavoured guitar fills. Closes Highway 61 Revisited.

lives.title: First performance
lives.note: Played in the solo acoustic half of the show, two days before the album came out.

lives.title: Unplugged
lives.note: Played with a small acoustic band for MTV, released on MTV Unplugged.

lives.title: Nightly again
lives.note: Back in almost every show of 2017, and again on the 2025 tour.
